question: The 20-Minute Whole Blood Clotting Test (20WBCT) is positive for haemotoxic viper envenomation when blood clots normally within 20 minutes.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Correct — this is false. The 20WBCT is positive when blood FAILS to clot within 20 minutes. Viper venom consumes clotting factors → incoagulable blood → positive test. If blood clots normally, the test is negative and haemotoxic envenomation is excluded. This zero-cost bedside test can be done in any rural clinic.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Incorrect. The 20WBCT is POSITIVE (confirming viper envenomation) when blood does NOT clot within 20 minutes (incoagulable blood = venom-induced consumption coagulopathy). Normal clotting within 20 minutes means a NEGATIVE test — haemotoxic envenomation is excluded.
